---
title: "Template for 96 Well Plate"
format: html
---

#import file
```{r}
#make sure you set the folder where your file is saved as the current working directory
#check whether the excel file names are the same and don't change the dataframe name
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

#Put in file names
hr_growth <- read_excel("_______.xlsx")

Overnight_withBacteriocin_E2_S4 <- read_excel("_______.xlsx")
```

#clean and combine
```{r}
Overnight_withBacteriocin$"Cycle Nr." <- as.numeric(Overnight_withBacteriocin_PUT_YOUR_FILE_NAME$"Cycle Nr.")

hr_growth$"Cycle Nr." <- as.numeric(hr_growth$"Cycle Nr.")
```

```{r}
Overnight_withBacteriocin_PUT_YOUR_FILE_NAME$"Cycle Nr." <- Overnight_withBacteriocin_PUT_YOUR_FILE_NAME$"Cycle Nr." + 6
```

```{r}
Overnight_withBacteriocin_PUT_YOUR_FILE_NAME$"Time [s]" <- Overnight_withBacteriocin_PUT_YOUR_FILE_NAME$"Time [s]" + 3000

```

```{r}
combined_df <- bind_rows(hr_growth, Overnight_withBacteriocin_PUT_YOUR_FILE_NAME)
```

```{r}
#preserve both cycle nr. and time
pivoted_OD <- combined_df%>%
  select(-3) %>% #if there's a temperature col, remove it before pivot_longer
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(1,2), names_to = "well_ID", values_to = "OD")
```

```{r}
#add other time units if you want 
df_clean <- pivoted_OD%>%
  mutate(Time_min=round(`Time [s]`/60,1),
         Time_h=round(Time_min/60,1))%>%
  rename(Cycle=`Cycle Nr.`,
         Time_s = `Time [s]`)%>% #rename if you want
  select(Cycle, Time_h, Time_min, everything()) #rearrange cols
```

```{r}
#remove useless dataframes if u want
rm(combined_df)
rm(pivoted_OD)
rm(Overnight_withBacteriocin_PUT_YOUR_FILE_NAME)
rm(hr_growth)
```

#make a key col
```{r}
df_clean<- df_clean |>
   mutate(key = case_when(
      str_detect(well_ID, "STRAIN NAME 1") ~ "STRAIN NAME 1",
    str_detect(well_ID,"STRAIN NAME 2") ~ "STRAIN NAME 2",
    TRUE ~ "LB"  # default for unmatched values
  ))

#final_data <- df_clean[, lapply(mean), by = well_ID]
```

```{r}
df_clean$well_ID_Copy <- df_clean$well_ID

df_clean<-df_clean %>%
  separate_wider_delim(
    cols = well_ID_Copy, #apply seperate on the duplicated col
    delim = "_",
    names = c("well", "conc", "type")
  )

df_clean<- df_clean %>%
  mutate(numeric_conc = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", conc))) #isolate the numeric value (e.g. bacteriocin conc)

df_clean$numeric_conc <- factor(df_clean$numeric_conc) #factorize it so curves can be colored by conc. numeric order
```

#calculate mean from replicates
```{r}
df_summarise <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(Time_h, conc, numeric_conc) %>%
  summarise(
    min=min(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    max=max(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean = mean(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(CV = sd/mean)

```


#plot curve
```{r} 
#Mean OD plot
NAME_1_curve<- df_summarise |>
  filter(key == "____") |>
ggplot( 
       aes(x = Time_h, y = mean, color = numeric_conc)) + #color by a factorized variable
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()+
  #geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = min, ymax = max, color = numeric_conc, group =numeric_conc), width = 0.2)+
   scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
   labs(title = "____",
        y="Mean OD",
        color="____",)

NAME_1_curve
```

```{r}
#change name
ggsave("./Plots/STRAIN_NAME_1_96well_time.png", plot = NAME_1_curve)
```

```{r}
#Plot
NAME_2_curve<- df_clean |>
  filter(key == "STRAIN_NAME_2") |>
ggplot( 
       aes(x = Time_h, y = OD, color = `well_ID`)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()+
   scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  labs(title = "Overnight_withBacteriocin_STRAIN_NAME_2")

STRAIN_NAME_2_curve
```

```{r}
ggsave("./Plots/STRAIN_NAME_2_curve_96well_261009.png", plot = NAME_2_curve)
```
